svg.title: When a search asks Paperless
svg.desc: As a page of Nextcloud loads, its search asks the app whether Paperless is a connected service for the user who signed in. While an administrator includes Paperless in every search of every user, it is not, and every search asks Paperless. Otherwise, while the administrators let users choose, a user who selected Always search my Paperless documents in the personal settings has every search of their own ask Paperless. Everybody else finds Paperless documents only with the switch Search connected services, which Nextcloud turns off again on every page that loads.
